name: Venture Company Mining
summary: In northern Stranglethorn, the Venture Company keeps finding Singing Blue Crystals. Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay wants ten brought back from the hills near Crystalvein Mine.

sections.title: Disrupting the Competition
sections.body: You’ve gathered Singing Blue Shards, and now Crank Fizzlebub points you toward a larger rival. The Venture Company’s work across the jungle cuts into the profits of independent goblins. Basilisks keep its miners out of Crystalvein Mine, so they dig in the hills around it for Singing Blue Crystals. Crank asks you to take ten from the miners and bring them to Booty Bay as proof of their setback.

sections.title: After the Crystals Arrive
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub calls his request righteous retribution against a ruthless cartel. When he sees the Singing Blue Crystals, his excitement gives away his true interest. He means to sell the stones in Booty Bay for a substantial fortune.

faq.q: Who gives the Venture Company Mining quest?
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub, a goblin in Booty Bay, asks for your help after you complete Singing Blue Shards.

faq.q: Where are the miners digging for these crystals?
faq.answer: Venture Company miners dig in the hills around Crystalvein Mine in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why aren't the Venture Company miners inside the mine?
faq.answer: Basilisks in Crystalvein Mine keep the Venture Company miners out, so they dig in the surrounding hills instead.

faq.q: What does Crank Fizzlebub ask you to bring him?
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub asks you to bring him ten Singing Blue Crystals taken from Venture Company miners near Crystalvein Mine.

faq.q: What came before Venture Company Mining?
faq.answer: Singing Blue Shards came first. Crank asks you to gather smaller crystal shards in Stranglethorn Vale.
